reason: The hypothesis directly restates the exact intervention, mechanism, and outcome already demonstrated in P5 and P9, where Hf addition to W-Ta-Cr-V eliminated Cr-V precipitation under irradiation at similar conditions. The proposal to test this known result at ~8 dpa and 1073 K, and to add a general claim about sinterability, does not go beyond the reported findings.
copied_elements: Adding Hf to W-Ta-Cr-V to suppress Cr-V precipitation
Mechanism: altered SRO and lattice distortion suppress precipitation
Predicted outcome: no precipitation, negligible hardening
Improved sinterability from Hf addition (general knowledge)
